processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Forged and cut into billets measuring 90 mm (length) × 70 mm (width) × 40 mm (thickness).
Yielded plates with a final thickness of 4 mm.
Annealing within the critical region (steel Ac1 = 705 °C, Ac3 = 950 °C); defines sample AN800.

structures.overall_structure: Multiphase heterogeneous microstructure of blocky/equiaxed ferrite (F) grains outlined by bainite (B), with thin film-like retained austenite (RA) and blocky fresh martensite (FM).

phases_present.morphology: distributes along ferrite grain boundaries, forming regions about 3 µm in size
blocky, attached to bainite (or islands comprising FM and RA)

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: RA size histogram (Fraction vs Diameter) peaks near 1.2 µm with D_AVE = 0.72 µm.

interfaces.phase_evolution: During intercritical annealing, portions of bainite and martensite re-austenitize due to the high solubility of carbon in austenite, leading to carbon enrichment and enhanced stability; carbon-depleted regions form ferrite, some carbon-enriched austenite is retained on cooling as RA, unstabilized austenite transforms diffusionlessly to fresh martensite, and bainite forms in regions not fully austenitized.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: field emission SEM (FEI Quanta-650 FEG); etched with 4% nitric acid ethanol solution
characterization_methods.key_findings: AN800 shows blocky ferrite outlined by bainite, with thin film-like retained austenite and blocky fresh martensite (Fig. 2(d)).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: EBSD-FEI Quanta-650 FEG; 20 kV operating voltage; scanning step size 0.2 µm; TSL OIM 7.0; BCC and FCC indexing; minimum pixel size 9
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: electropolishing at 28 V and 0.1 A for 15–30 s; electrolyte 80% ethanol, 15% perchloric acid, 5% glycerol
characterization_methods.purpose: phase distribution and retained austenite quantification
characterization_methods.key_findings: AN800 phase table FCC 0.011 / BCC 0.989; RA content 1.1 vol%; RA D_AVE = 0.72 µm (Fig. 3(c) and 3(e)).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: accelerating voltage 40 kV, tube current 40 mA, scanning angle range 30°–110° on the rolling plane
characterization_methods.key_findings: XRD γ reflections for AN800 confirm retained austenite; XRD confirms RA content decreasing with increasing annealing temperature (Fig. 3(f)).

unmapped_findings: AN800 is the intercritically annealed condition (800 °C / 30 min, air-cooled) and is distinct from AN800-T, which received an additional low-bainite aging at 400 °C for 30 min. The tensile properties reported in the paper (yield strength 985 MPa, tensile strength 1 295 MPa, elongation 18.7%) belong to AN800-T, not to this AN800 sample.

Steel critical transformation temperatures determined by dilatometry: Ac1 = 705 °C, Ac3 = 950 °C, Bf = 380 °C, Ms = 346 °C; the 800 °C annealing of AN800 lies within the Ac1–Ac3 critical region (b0149).
